# Plugin.Maui.MVVMExpress.Dialogs

MauiDialogs implements IDialogs with DisplayAlert. ViewModels must not call Page.

NuGet: https://www.nuget.org/packages/Plugin.Maui.MVVMExpress.Dialogs
GitHub: https://github.com/nuvyntralabs/Plugin.Maui.MVVMExpress
Docs: https://nuvyntralabs.github.io/packages/plugin-maui-mvvmexpress/
Catalog: https://github.com/nuvyntralabs/MauiEssentials
License: MIT
Version: 0.1.0-preview (`--prerelease`)

## Supported versions

net10.0, net10.0-android (API 21+), net10.0-ios (iOS 15+)

## Installation

dotnet add package Plugin.Maui.MVVMExpress.Dialogs --prerelease

Register `IDialogs` → `MauiDialogs`. Tests: NullDialogs or FakeDialogs.

## Use this package when

- A MAUI app needs alerts/confirms from a ViewModel through IDialogs

## Do not use when

- Tests only — use Core NullDialogs or Plugin.Maui.MVVMExpress.Testing FakeDialogs
- They need custom popup UI — CommunityToolkit.Maui or a custom IDialogs adapter

## Alternatives

CommunityToolkit.Maui popups, Prism.Maui dialogs, Page.DisplayAlert.
